name: Funding capitulation washout — long the cleansed short-crowd (spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC + a CROSS-event op no existing funding spec uses. Mechanism stated before the data: when perp funding crosses DOWN through a fitted negative floor it marks the moment perp SHORTS become crowded and over-pay to stay short (a leverage capitulation in progress, not a static level). Pairing that capitulation INSTANT with price having already stopped falling (a short-window ret above a fitted knife-guard floor) buys the cleansed short-squeeze bottom: the marginal short is exhausted and spot reverts UP as covers chase price. The orthogonal second metric is REALIZED VOL — we require vol BELOW a fitted ceiling so we fade an orderly capitulation, not a free-falling crash where the funding print lags. This is distinct from funding-reset-reversion (RSI + funding LEVEL, no cross, no vol gate), from funding-contrarian-crash-filter (a SHORT that fades positive-funding crowded LONGS — the opposite leverage side), and from funding-gated-momentum (funding as a LEVEL ceiling on a momentum LONG). Disconfirmer 1: the edge must be the funding cross_down EXTREME mean-reverting; a plain spot long over the same sample/costs must not match the deflated Sharpe. Disconfirmer 2: replace the funding cross_down with a funding LEVEL lt — if the static-level read does as well, the cross adds nothing and this is a re-skin of the existing funding-reversion. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): net of ~20bps Binance spot round-trip the bounce must clear. tier0 features (funding_rate, vol_realized, ret_Nd), fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: funding crosses DOWN into a crowded-short capitulation while price has stopped declining and vol is contained — a cleansed short-squeeze bottom, bought on spot
